purpose: Server-only bridge from Next.js admin routes/actions to SHRESTA-BE admin APIs.
businessRules: This module must be imported only by server routes or server actions.
SHRESTA_ADMIN_API_KEY must never be exposed through NEXT_PUBLIC variables or client components.
Every backend mutation helper requires a caller-supplied idempotency key.
Asset and category data remains backend-owned and is never normalized into frontend constants.
Asset contracts include categoryFamilyKey, categoryProductTypeKey, productSku, tags, alt text, SEO fields, generated variants, S3/CDN URLs, and optimization stats.
Existing image replacement uses POST /api/v1/admin/assets/{assetKey}/image with multipart FormData and an idempotency key.
Multipart admin requests classify backend network failures and backend API 404 responses as ShrestaApiUnavailableError using SHRESTA service wording for unavailable messages.
The active ACL model uses only SUPER_ADMIN, CHANGE_SUBMITTER, CHANGE_REVIEWER, and CHANGE_MANAGER.
Create/update/archive/delete dashboard submissions should use admin change request APIs unless the endpoint is explicitly an approved apply path.
